steps.name: checkpoint-fingerprint
steps.summary: src/backtest.py adds compute_config_fingerprint(config) + FINGERPRINT_KEYS tuple (data_path, feature_mode, target params, lgbm_params, train/retrain/val windows, embargo_days, OOS holdout, EWMA params). save_checkpoint accepts optional config; load_checkpoint accepts optional config and discards cache on fingerprint mismatch (returns None). Legacy payloads without _fingerprint accepted with warning (backward compat). run_variant.py:342-344 passes cfg to load_checkpoint. tests/test_checkpoint_fingerprint.py: 13/13 passing (function stability, SAFE-key invariance, FINGERPRINT-key sensitivity, save/load roundtrip, legacy compat). No legacy outputs/checkpoints/ existed to archive.

steps.name: pca-target-scale
steps.summary: Added pca_target_scale_mode field (default 'raw', option 'daily_eq'). Patched compute_specific_returns + compute_specific_returns_regime_weighted to divide residual by sqrt(forward_horizon) under daily_eq. Added to FINGERPRINT_KEYS. variants/exp_pca_scale_daily_eq.yaml A/B run: trim_IR 0.392 -> 0.820 (Δ +0.428!), full_IR 1.017 -> 0.734 (Δ -0.283), rolling_ir_mean 0.588 -> 0.846. |Δ trim_IR| >> 0.02 → downstream modules are HIGHLY sensitive to residual magnitude (likely signal_stability_lambda / PEAD / EMA blending). Step file's prohibition honored: default unchanged at 'raw'; daily_eq stays as a future-investigation lever. Filed as future work to isolate which downstream module is the leverage point. outputs/exp_pca_scale/comparison.md documents result.

steps.name: rolling-ir-eval
steps.summary: src/analytics.py extended with rolling_ir, rolling_ir_stats, spa_pvalue (Hansen 2005 simplified single-strategy SPA, block_size=10, n_iter=1000, seed=42). compute_metrics() emits 7 new keys: rolling_ir_{mean,median,min,max,pos_frac,window} + spa_pvalue. run_variant.py _summarize prints rolling IR + SPA p-value lines. tests/test_analytics_rolling_spa.py: 9/9 (strong-alpha case for SPA gives p<0.05 reliably; zero-alpha case has median p~0.5 across 20 seeds). scripts/backfill_metrics.py back-filled 11 existing metrics.json files. Headline: iter15_FINAL_postfix rolling_ir_mean=0.588 SPA p=0.0010; baseline_v5 rolling_ir_mean=0.981 SPA p=0.0000.
